name: Modern rules
author: DecompRecomp
description: Rules from the later games: one card drawn a turn after the opening five, no card lost to a fusion that does not work, and Pot of Greed (draw two). Needs Extra hand plays.

settings.label: Playing a card is optional
settings.description: START in the first hand of a turn plays no card and goes on to the field, as in the later games. Without it a full field with nothing that fuses would leave no legal play.

settings.label: Draw one card a turn
settings.description: Each side opens with five cards, then draws one a turn (none on the first turn). Off refills the hand to five each turn, as on the disc.

settings.label: Keep cards a fusion cannot use
settings.description: Cards put onto a monster must fuse with it or equip it, and marked cards must all fuse or equip in that order, so no card is thrown away. The player's confirm is refused; the CPU plays elsewhere, or no card.

settings.label: Pot of Greed draws two
settings.description: Using Pot of Greed draws two cards and brings the hand back up. Cards that do not fit in the hand wait for the next draw. The CPU uses it too.

settings.label: Pot of Greed copies for testing
settings.description: Keeps this many Pot of Greed in your trunk and deck together, so the card can be tried out. 0 turns it off. To be removed once testing is done.
